scope: Focused fresh follow-up, separate from the release gate; not a full runtime/platform release qualification

protocol.scope: Focused fresh follow-up, separate from the release gate; not a full runtime/platform release qualification
protocol.order: Six rotation/reversal permutations, repeated twice; each variant occupies each position four times

noise.ioProbe: 8 sequential stat + readFile pairs on an independent 4 KiB fixture, on the same filesystem as the workload
noise.filter: Reject the whole three-variant round for each case if any of its before/after CPU or filesystem probes exceeds its fixed threshold. Never filter on measured workload time.

statistics.observation: Per-process median of two timed measurements; paired by round
statistics.control: 95% interval contains zero and is contained within [-5,+5] percent
statistics.nonRegression: Both repair-vs-baseline and repair-vs-control 95% relative slowdown upper bounds <= 0

protocol.stopping: Exactly 12 rounds; no additional favorable rounds or changed thresholds. Functional failures invalidate the attempt and are preserved. No concurrent tests, profiling or benchmark processes.
